openLabel.note: VoiceOver label of a card's header; title is the card's name.

detail.goneHint: It was removed, here or on another device.

history.note: Section header on an opened insight; currency is a code.

historyHint.message: Whole months before {period}, worked out the way a budget's suggestions are.

detail.noHistory: Nothing was spent here in the months before this one yet.

budgets.note: Section header: each budget's state in the period shown.

over.note: VoiceOver, on a budget line that went over its limit.

spentOf.note: Under a budget line; both are money with the currency.

coming.note: Section header; day is the next payday, "30 Sep".

income.note: Section header on Days to salary: what came in, period by period.

detail.noIncome: No income has been logged in these months yet.

showCurrency.note: VoiceOver, on the arrows that switch an opened insight's chart to another currency.

incomeFrom.note: Section header: this period's income grouped by payee and category.

detail.noMoves: Nothing has been logged on this account yet.

goal.note: Section header on a savings goal's details.

pace.note: Section header on an account's details: the average change per month.

avgChange.message: {count, plural, one {Change per month · # month} other {Change per month · avg of # months}}
avgChange.note: Average of what the balance went up or down by in each complete month.

eta.note: Row label; the value is when the goal would be reached.

balance.message: Balance at the end of each month · {account}
balance.note: Section header over the balance chart; account is a name.

monthA11y.note: VoiceOver, one month of an account.

counted.note: Section header: recurring payments included in the total.

notCounted.note: Section header: recurring payments left out of the total in the card's settings.

perWeekHistory.note: Section header over a weekly history chart.

perMonthHistory.note: Section header over a monthly history chart.

counts.note: Section header: the accounts a safety buffer adds up.

together.note: All counted accounts converted into one currency.

essentialHistory.message: What a month of it cost · {currency}
essentialHistory.note: Section header over the comfort level's spending per month.

checklistSums.note: Section header on a payments checklist's details.

stillToPay.note: Row label; roughly what the open lines will cost.

paid.note: Row label: what the checklist's lines were paid this period.

inAll.note: Row label: paid plus still to pay.

chartA11y.note: VoiceOver label of a history chart.

perYear.note: Income history: the monthly average times 12.

$comment: The Insights tab, the insight editor and the reorder sheet. `period` arguments are "Aug 2026" or "15 Aug – 14 Sep"; `amount` arguments are formatted money with the currency code.
emptyHint: Cards that answer one question each — what is safe to spend, how long until salary, how a savings goal is going, what your subscriptions cost a year. Add them with + at the top.
gone: This kind of insight is no longer available — remove it with the ⋯ button.
noBudgets: No budgets for this period yet.

recurring.note: Name of a recurring rule with no payee and no category.

days.note: Big number on the Until salary card.

months.note: "3 months"; also the big number on Safety buffer, which may be a fraction (1.5).

perDay.note: Line under a card; the tag makes the amount bold.

of.note: Progress towards a target: "1 200.00 EUR of 5 000.00 EUR".

committed.message: {amount} of it is still to be charged before {day}
committed.note: Under the budgets left; day is "30 Sep".

perDayAfter.note: The tag makes the amount bold.

left.note: Under the balance; account is an account name.

leftPending.note: amount is the balance once the pending entries are counted.

inOut.note: What came in and went out this period.

tickedLabel.message: {name}, ticked off without a payment. Tap to untick.

ticked.note: Under a checklist line marked done by hand.

askBody.message: Log the payment, or tick it off without one — paid in cash, or not needed this time.
askBody.note: Alert after tapping an open checklist line; its title is the line's name.

askLog.note: Alert button: opens a new entry prefilled from the last payment.

askTick.note: Alert button: mark the line done for this period without a transaction.

lastMonth.message: Last month {amount} · {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}
lastMonth.note: Under a checklist line paid several times a month: what the previous period came to in all, and how many payments.

paid.note: Under a checklist line done this period: everything paid on it so far.

last.note: The last payment in this category; day is "22 Sep".

due.note: Recurring payment line not paid yet; day is "22 Sep".

summaryLeft.note: Checklist summary part: roughly what the open lines will still cost.

times.note: A weekly payment paid once of the four times it falls this period: "1 of 4".

timesLabel.note: VoiceOver for the progress dots of a payment due several times this period.

paidCount.note: Under the checklist card: how many lines are already paid; they are listed on the details screen.

perMonth.note: Under the yearly total: the same divided by 12. The tag makes the amount bold.

perYear.message: per year · {included} of {count, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}}

amountPer.note: "9.99 EUR per month"; per is insights.per.*.

per.daily: {count, plural, =1 {per day} one {every # day} other {every # days}}
per.weekly: {count, plural, =1 {per week} one {every # week} other {every # weeks}}
per.monthly: {count, plural, =1 {per month} one {every # month} other {every # months}}
per.yearly: {count, plural, =1 {per year} one {every # year} other {every # years}}

window.message: averaged over {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}

weekly.note: names is a list of categories.

monthly.note: names is a list of categories.

share.message: of {period} went on what you could not live without

values.trendSame: Essentials were {pct}% six periods ago — about the same
values.trendLess: Essentials were {pct}% six periods ago — less room than there was
values.trendMore: Essentials were {pct}% six periods ago — more room than there was

openCategory.note: VoiceOver; name is a category in the importance split.

more.note: After four tappable category names in one importance level; tapping shows the rest.

values.unmarked: Categories nobody has marked are counted separately, not guessed at.

liveChosenPlain.message: you could live on your money at your comfort level

liveImportantPlain.message: you could live on your money, paying for what matters most

monthCosts.message: A month costs {amount}, averaged over {periods} periods.

cushion.message: That includes {pct}% for the unexpected on top of {amount} a month.

accounts.note: On an opened Safety buffer; accounts is a list of account names.

buffer.noEssentials: Nothing is marked as essential yet.
buffer.noEssentialsHint: Settings → Categories → Set what matters, or choose the categories of your comfort level on this card. Then this says how many months you could live on your money.

explain.message: {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} of what matters most, averaging {amount} a month over {periods} periods. The target moves on its own as life gets more expensive.

explainChosen.message: {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} at your comfort level, averaging {amount} a month over {periods} periods. The target moves on its own as life gets more expensive.

noRate.message: No exchange rate for {currencies} yet, so that money is left out.

short.message: {amount} more is due than the budgets have left — worth a look before payday.

free_money.title: Left in budgets
free_money.hint: What is left of your budgets this period, and what is still to be charged

days_to_salary.title: Until salary
days_to_salary.hint: Days left in the period and what you can spend per day

savings_goal.title: Savings goal
savings_goal.hint: Progress of an account towards a target

account_balance.title: Account balance
account_balance.hint: What is left on one account, and what moved this period

checklist.title: Payments checklist
checklist.hint: Which of these categories still have no transaction this period

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions per year
subscriptions.hint: What your recurring expenses cost yearly

regular.title: Regular spending
regular.hint: Weekly or monthly average for a category

values.title: What it went on
values.hint: This period split by how much each category matters to you

safety_buffer.title: Safety buffer
safety_buffer.hint: How many months you could live on your money

bufferAccounts.note: Safety buffer row: the accounts whose money counts.

bufferAccountsHint.message: Choose the accounts you would live on if the income stopped — savings, the current account, cash. Their money is added up and divided by what a month costs.

cushionSubtitle.message: A month is reckoned 10% dearer, for the bills nobody plans

goal.note: Section above the months the safety buffer should cover.

noGoal.note: Segment: the safety buffer has no target.

goalHint.message: How many months you would like the money to cover. Without a goal the card just says how long it lasts.

averageOver.note: Section above 3 / 6 / 12 months on Regular spending.

edit.question: What do you want to see?
edit.offeredOnce: Cards with nothing to set are offered once — the ones you already have are not listed again.

defaultTitle.note: Subtitle when no title is set; title is the kind's name.

choose.note: Row subtitle when nothing is picked yet.

comfort.note: Safety buffer setting: the categories a month has to pay for.

mostImportant.note: Comfort level row when no categories are chosen.

spending.note: Section in the Add insight list.

accounts.note: Section in the Add insight list.

payments.note: Section in the Add insight list.

addNow.note: Right side of a card kind with nothing to set: tapping adds it at once.

required.note: Row subtitle (in orange) for a setting the card cannot be saved without.

none.note: Categories row when the checklist only watches recurring payments.

title.note: Section above the chosen categories of a payments checklist.

once.message: Once · tap to wait once per tag
once.note: Subtitle of a chosen category with no tags picked.

hint.message: One category paid for several people — insurance for each of you — is one line per tag: done when a payment in it carries that tag.

title.note: Toggle on the payments checklist editor.

subtitle.message: Also wait for every recurring expense due this period

which.note: Section listing the recurring expenses the checklist waits for, each with a tick.

whichHint.message: Untick a payment you only make when it is needed: the checklist stops waiting for it.

preview.note: Section header above a live preview of the card being set up.

reorder.title: Reorder insights
reorder.hint: Drag by the grip on the right. The order here is the order on Insights.
reorder.emptyHint: Add one on the Insights tab first.
